reports.notes: Griffith tied bar on slab 7B, and UCI formed slab 7B. MJE poured the exterior curb, while the dirt crews were off for the day. Ironhorse stripped the stem wall for the DVO office building and completed block outs, and Bennet installed drain piping in the DVO buildings and continued backfilling

Griffith tied bar on slab 7B, while UCI formed slab 7B. MJE stripped the exterior curb and began grading around the octagon pits in preparation for concrete. The dirt crews continued backfilling around the buildings, and Ironhorse was off for the day. Bennet installed piping in the DVO buildings and backfilled the rain gutter PVC pipes. Ag Pray Foam started spray foaming the exterior of the digester, and DVO began staging their HDPE pipes that will connect to the DVO building

Griffith tied bar on slab 7B and pre-tied walls, while UCI formed the next sump base. MJE set the east exterior curb and is ready to pour cement tomorrow morning. The dirt crews continued backfilling around the buildings, and Ironhorse was off for the day. Bennet installed brackets and all six pumps into the inlet pit and continued backfilling around the DVO building. DVO set up their HDPE pipes inside the DVO building, and their electrical crew installed conduits into the main electric building. QDC’s Jimmy crew started running conduits for the six pumps inside the inlet pit as well as for the backup generator, and Jared installed the H2S sensor in the post screw press building.

On 11/5, Griffith pre-tied walls, while UCI assisted with the slab pour and poured the next sump base. MJE set the east exterior curb and installed blockouts between the hollow core. The dirt crews continued backfilling around the DVO area, and Ironhorse was off. DVO’s electrical crew continued adding brackets in the main electrical building and running conduit, while a second DVO crew began installing I-beams on cells 1, 2, 5, and
QDC continued adding conduits for the pumps in the inlet pit, started placing brackets for the AW cabinets, and ran conduits for the VFD in the main electrical building. Bennett’s first crew welded HDPE and connected the bypass line, Varcor line, and post screw pit line into the vault, while their second crew installed check valves, ﬂow meters, and air relief valves for all six pumps in the inlet pit. The plumbing crew began adding PVC units in the DVO office building, and QDC’s second crew worked on the octagon pits, preparing them for a cement pour in the morning. Jared installed the post screw press H2S sensor and the fiber barn H2S sensor.

DVO started placing underground direct burial wire for the heat pumps. QDC added a drain water line to the recycle pit, repaired the conduits running from Barn 3 to the screw press barn, and began backfilling around the recycle pit with Jared assisting on the conduit repairs. Bennett’s first crew finished electrical fusion work on the bypass line, varcor line, and ﬂush screw pit line into the vault, while the second crew continued installing check valves, ﬂow meters, and air relief valves for all six pumps in the inlet pit, completing five of them. Griffith pre-tied walls, UCI stripped the sump base and slab and prepped slab 7A.1, and MJE poured the east exterior curb and blockout between the hollow core. After completing the hollow core work, MJE also finished pouring concrete by the octagon pits. Dirt crews continued backfilling around the DVO area, and Ironhorse was off.

Bennett started digging a trench for the 6-inch fire line, the 3-inch water line, and the conduit fiber line. The rest of the crew finished adding check valves, ﬂow meters, and air relief valves for all six pumps in the inlet, and they also installed a ladder in the inlet pit. QDC’s first crew, led by Jimmy, continued adding more conduits in the main electrical room and began backfilling with sand, while QDC’s second crew completed installing the new PVC water line into the recycling pit and backfilled the entire area. The plumbing crew came out today to reduce the 3-inch shower line to a 2-inch drain in the DVO office building. Griffith pre-tied walls and slab 7A.1, UCI formed slab 7A.1 and started setting wall forms, and MJE worked on the east exterior curb and blockout between the hollow core, reset sections, and poured concrete in the vault to cover all the HDPE pipes. Dirt crews continued backfilling around DVO, while Ironhorse was off for the day. Jared prepped for heat trace wiring and worked on getting alarms for H2S sensors

Bennett continued backfilling around the vault while the rest of the crew welded 4-inch HDPE for the gas line and water liner. Griffith tied rebar on slab 7A.1. UCI set wall forms but had to shut down the crane due to wind, so the crew cleaned up the west side of the DVO. MJE worked on the south exterior curb and blockout between the hollow core, while the dirt crews and Ironhorse were off.

QDC continued adding the 1-inch conduits that run to the inlet pit in the main electrical room and also transitioned the 1-inch fiber conduit from barn 3 to a 2-inch line leading to the server room. The second QDC crew began preparing the ground wire for the KW transformer pad on the south side. J&R Construction started grading and adding gravel around the octagon pits for the pumps and agitators, while Thermal Pro began installing heat trace and adding removable covers for the pumps and agitators. Bennett continued digging the trench for the water line, fire hydrant line, and fiber line, and their second crew started welding 3- inch HDPE for the water line. Griffith set rebar curtains on wall 37, while UCI set forms for the same wall. MJE prepped the hollow core seams with backer rod, placed sand over conduits in the DVO buildings, and set the vault lid. Dirt crews continued backfilling around the DVO area, and Ironhorse prepped the electrical building slab and the south transformer pad, setting forms to pour concrete tomorrow

Bennett’s crew continued welding the 3-inch HDPE pipe for the water line that transitions to a 2-inch line and also welded the 4-inch HDPE gas line that reduces to a 1-inch gas line leading to the ﬂare. They also tied in the 4-inch HDPE pipe for the boiler in the DVO building, while Bennett’s second crew continued backfilling and installed the fire hydrant. QDC continued adding 2-inch conduit from the main electrical room for the fiber line and signal lines,also added a 2-inch fiber conduit to the DVO building, and installed a 1-inch conduit for the H2S sensor inside the DVO building. J&R Construction continued grading and adding gravel to the octagon pits, for the pumps and agitators. Thermal Pro continued adding heat trace and installing removable covers for the pumps and agitators. Griffith pre-tied curtains on 7A.1, UCI set forms for wall 37, and MJE prepped hollow core seams with backer rod, stripped the commodity barn patch, and swept and cleaned cell 1. Dirt crews continued backfilling around the DVO and prepping for seeding, while Ironhorse installed foam in the DVO buildings.

QDC continued running the 2-inch fiber line to the ﬂare and also started running 2-inch signal and power conduit from the south side electrical room to the ﬂare. The QDC second crew began installing the garage door in the post screw press room and installed a valve on the PVC line that runs to the recycling pit. Bennett’ s crew tied in the 8-inch HDPE varcor line into the post screw pit and continued backfilling the water line, gas line, and fire hydrant. Thermal Pro continued adding heat trace and installing removable covers for the pumps and agitators. UCI continued setting forms for wall 37, while Griffith continued pre-tying walls and added stainless steel brackets in cell 6 to support the hollow core. MJE prepared hollow core seams with backer rod and poured concrete in the octagon pits by the pumps and agitators, with their second crew continuing backfilling around the DVO building with dirt and sand. Iron Horse poured concrete on the south side electrical room and the pad where the transformer sits.

Griffith continued installing the stainless-steel bracket for the hollow core and tied rebar for slab 8B. UCI poured wall 37, and MJE continued backfilling around the DVO buildings. Dirt crews backfilled around DVO and prepared the area for seeding. Ironhorse prepped and poured the door aprons. Bennett continued welding HDPE pipe for the water line, installed two more fire hydrants on the south side by the ﬂare, continued backfilling around the DVO building, installed pipe supports at the octagon pits for the pumps and agitators, started welding 2-inch ﬂanges for the water line, and cut 4x4 on the concrete DMT slab for the frost- free hose bib. QDC continued running conduits from the main electrical building to the inlet pit, and Thermal Pro continued adding heat trace and installing removable covers for the pumps and agitators.

Griffith tied rebar for slab 8B and set curtains, while UCI stripped wall 37 and set forms on wall 38. MJE continued backfilling the DVO buildings, and dirt crews also worked on backfilling around the DVO area and prepping for seeding. Ironhorse installed interior foam on the DVO office building and assisted with backfill efforts. Bennet installed piping around the DVO facility, backfilled trenches, and started installing drains in the main DVO building.thermal pro guys finished up installing all the removable covers

MJE continued backfilling the DVO building with sand and dirt, while Bennet installed ﬂoor and sink drains in the DVO building and continued backfilling. Ironhorse started adding rebar inside the DVO building in preparation for Monday’s concrete work. Griffith, UCI, and QDC crews were off for the day.

Griffith set curtains, UCI stripped wall 37 and set forms on wall 38, and MJE backfilled around the DVO buildings. Dirt crews continued prepping for seeding and concrete around the fiber barn, while Ironhorse installed interior foam on the DVO office building and poured the south section of the DVO building. Bennet added the oil separators in the DVO building, installed a 4-inch valve on the water line by the post screw pit, and continued backfilling. QDC began preparing rebar and grading around the south side of barn 3 for concrete, and the Midwest crew started prepping to set up the walls on the south side electrical room.

Griffith set curtains and tied bar on slab 8B, while UCI stripped wall 37 and set forms on wall 38. MJE backfilled the DVO buildings, poured the south curb of the DVO area, and assisted UCI. Dirt crews prepped for concrete around the fiber barn, and Ironhorse worked on prepping the north section of the DVO building.
Bennett continued digging for the 18-inch storm drain, placed the manhole, and kept backfilling. The Midwest crew started placing walls on the south side of the electrical building, and J&R poured the concrete slab by barn 3 and began preparing the north side slab

Griffith tied bar on slab 8B, UCI stripped wall 37 and set forms on wall 38, and MJE formed slab 8B and set forms on the wall on slab 7A.1. Dirt crews continued prepping for concrete around the fiber barn, while Ironhorse worked on prepping the DVO office building. Bennet continued welding HDPE, installing the storm drain by the DVO, and pouring concrete around the manhole. Pennick crews began digging their trench for the septic tank, and QDC continued pouring concrete around the barn 3 area. Midwest continued installing walls around the south side electrical room

Griffith tied bar on slab 8B, UCI installed grout plugs and poured wall 38, and MJE set forms on the wall on slab 7A.1. The dirt crews prepped for concrete around the fiber barn and began work on the new lagoon, while Ironhorse poured the north section of the DVO office building. Bennet continued installing the 18-inch storm drain, tying it into the digester, and backfilling. QDC started installing the motors for the pumps in the inlet pit, Midwest continued placing walls on the south side electrical room, and the J&R group poured additional concrete by the octagon pits. Also pennick group finished installing the septic tank.

Griffith pre-tied the walls for 8B, UCI stripped wall 38 and set forms on wall 39, and MJE set forms on the wall on slab 7A.1. The dirt crews pumped water and cleaned the roads, Ironhorse was off due to rain, and Bennet installed bollards in the octagon pits, completing about 75% of the work. Midwest began preparing the walls on the DVO building, and the QDC crew finished installing the windows in the fiber barn room.

Griffith pre-tied the walls for 8B, UCI stripped wall 38 and set forms on wall 39, and MJE set forms on the wall on slab 7A.1. The dirt crews pumped water and cleaned the roads, Ironhorse poured the DVO office and approaches, and QDC added the 4-inch conduit running from the main south-side transformer to the power line. Bennet and the Midwest West crew were off. During my walkthrough, I confirmed that all insulation pads on the pipes by the octagon pits were on and working, and the heaters in the upstairs fiber room were on and functioning. I also spoke with Hayden, who will begin installing the heaters down in the digester tomorrow.

Griffith pre-tied walls for 8B, UCI poured wall 39 and set up blankets and a heater, and MJE poured wall 7A.1 and also put up blankets and a heater. The dirt crews pumped water and cleaned the roads, Ironhorse placed blankets on their pour from yesterday, and Bennet was off.
